text:
ryan: Heads up — planning an unpin of runtime 2.15 during Monday's change window. Found an SDK mismatch in canary that could break some quant models. Can we triage quickly?

maya: Which SDK version causes it?

ryan: SDK 1.8.0-beta renamed the kvcache public API (`kv_cache.lookup` -> `kvcache.get`). Most non-quant models are fine but quantized LLMs (llama3-q, quant-v4b) hit an exception in canary.

amy: Oof. Where did that show up? logs or CI?

ryan: Canary runs in eu-west. Logs show repeated stack traces like: `AttributeError: 'KVCache' object has no attribute 'lookup'` after warm-start. Repro in local canary env with small prompt.

ben: Deploybot pinlist says runtime 2.15 is currently slated to be unpinned on 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC. If SDK is already rolled to 1.8 on canary, unpin will expose users.

deploybot: current-pinlist: {"runtime": "2.15", "models": ["llama3-q", "quant-v4b"], "unpin_date": "2026-04-06T02:00:00Z"} (use `/deploy pinlist show runtime` to modify)

sam: Quick options: 1) Delay unpin until SDK 1.8 compatibility shim lands, 2) Patch SDK canary to provide alias `lookup`, 3) Scoped unpin (hosted non-quant only).

maya: I prefer (3) scoped unpin for hosted non-quant first, keep quant pinned until shim/patch. Limits blast radius.

amy: +1. Also add a telemetry flag to catch `AttributeError: .*lookup` in the next 24h so we can measure exposure.

ryan: Agreed. Action items:
- ben: update pinlist to exclude quant models and add note. Command:```/deploy pinlist update runtime 2.15 --exclude-models llama3-q,quant-v4b --reason "SDK 1.8 kvcache rename; scoped unpin for non-quant"```
- maya: land compatibility shim in SDK canary (alias `kv_cache.lookup` -> `kvcache.get`) and notify when ready.
- amy: add telemetry rule and dashboard panel for the error.
- sam: schedule a follow-up check 6h after pinned change window.

ben: On it. Will post PR + deploybot confirmation when updated. ETA 30m.

deploybot: pinlist updated: runtime 2.15 unpin scoped -> hosted-non-quant. quant models remain pinned. Audit ticket: RN-4521.

maya: Working on shim now, will ping when merged.

ryan: Thanks team. We'll keep EU canary blocked for quant until we see a clean canary run. If shim lands, we'll re-evaluate full unpin. :thumbsup:

ben: PR merged and pinlist commit pushed. deploybot confirmation: `/deploy pinlist show runtime` -> shows quant models still pinned.

sam: Follow-up check set for 6h post-change window in calendar.

amy: Telemetry rule created (RN-4521). Dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/rn-4521 (cc @ryan)

ryan: Good. Closing this thread — will reopen if new errors surface.
